Done. Here's the summary of this QA run.

## Frontend QA — 2026-07-22 — RESULT: CONVERGED, nothing broken

**0 bugs found · 0 fixes · 0 commits.**

### What I verified
1. **Convergence precondition (proven empty):** Both `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- server/src client/src` and `git status --porcelain -- client/src server/src` returned nothing. HEAD (`73dd7b2`) is byte-identical in source to baseline `2d7fb57`. Every commit since the last audit (2026-06-19) is an automated `checkpoint:`/`docs:` commit touching no source. **No new route/page/component files** — the one condition that would justify a full re-sweep.

2. **Fresh Playwright runtime evidence** (not trusting stale memory):
   - Vite up on :5173 (200)
   - Login form pre-filled (`waterloo`) → clicked Sign In → **Dashboard rendered full structure**: sidebar nav (Dashboard/Storm Map/Storm Archive/Pipeline/Leads/Jobs/Finance/Operations/Settings), Cmd-K search, filter bar (All Time/7/30/90/YTD + All Reps/All Sources), 5 stat cards, funnel, Team Leaderboard table
   - Navigated to `/leads` → rendered clean (sidebar incl. Admin, Leads table)
   - **Post-login console: 0 errors / 0 warnings**
   - The 4 unique 401s (import-progress, notifications, tenant-settings, auth/refresh) are the documented **pre-login boot auth-check** that fires before the `/login` redirect — a known non-bug, cumulative-since-session-start only.

### Why no page-by-page sweep
The full per-page sweep is proven redundant by the empty-diff precondition: the frontend is byte-identical to the baseline that converged as recently as 2026-07-21 (Run 54, full Playwright sweep of all pages + 15 Settings tabs). Re-driving every page would produce identical evidence at real token cost. I confirmed the app is live and healthy with a fresh smoke instead.

### Carried gaps (both out of charter — not fixed by design)
- Esc-to-close keyboard nav = an *enhancement* (charter forbids adding features)
- EstimateBuilder at 375px sidebar collapse = phone width, mobile **paused** (works at 768px+)

No commit was made — the charter says commit after every *fix*, and there were none. Resume file and MEMORY.md index updated for the next run.
